_doc: PBR material classes for the level textures, read by tools/pbr_classify.py (and pbr_layer.py). classes: roughness/metallic per class. rules: keywords matched in the texture's base name, first matching rule wins (order matters). A keyword of at most 3 letters inside a longer word (not at its start or end) is a weak match: ignored except in legacy rules (the original pbr_layer.py keyword list, kept so the installed layer does not change) and listed in the report. exceptions: exact texture paths, override everything else; give a reason (an exception naming the material Jev chose keeps Jev's roughness/metal; the 2026-10-28 review of the rule-vs-Jev conflicts added most of them). haze_glass: translucent haze sheets that get no material (Remix keeps the blended look). glass_words: SURF_TRANS33/66 textures whose base name contains one of these become thin-walled translucent glass. flag_rules: BSP surface flags/usage, see pbr_classify.py.

metal.about: bare metal: steel, pipes, grates, girders, machinery

tech.about: doors, trims, painted tech panels, mixed metal/plastic

sign.about: painted signs, posters, pictures, paintings, labels

light.about: lamps and light fixtures, light panels (emission comes from the emissive layers)

default.about: unclassified: generic painted walls, floors, unknown
